findings.problem: Composition.meta.profile does not include OPConsultRecord, the profile expected for hiType "OPConsultation"
findings.why: The M2 data push's hiType tells the HIU what profile to expect; a bundle whose Composition carries a different (or no) profile fails validation on their side.
OPConsultRecord requires Composition.meta.profile to declare https://nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/StructureDefinition/OPConsultRecord so the HIU's profile validation can match the bundle against it.
OPConsultRecord requires Composition.author (min 1); a Composition without it fails NRCES profile validation.

limits: This is a structural check against the pinned NRCES profiles (ndhm.in 0.7.2) plus ABDM transport rules. It does not validate terminology and is not a certification. Run the official HL7 validator with the same IG version for full conformance; the catalogue's validator recipe atom explains how.
